_note: PLACEHOLDER baseline for the v0.1.4 release. Sprint D4 introduces 4 new criterion groups under `server_rpc` measuring the production gRPC stack (loopback TCP + tonic codec + interceptors + bridge + backend) with 4 SLO targets `SLO-D4-1..3` + `SLO-D4-T1`. Indicative numbers from the M3 Pro reference run (`cargo bench -p efe-server --bench server_rpc -- --quick`): full_stack small ~180 ms, medium ~370 ms, large ~370 ms ; minimal_stack tracks within ±10 % (the Δ_interceptors is sub-millisecond and below the loopback noise floor) ; concurrent c8 small ~390 ms (8 RPCs/batch ⇒ ~20 req/s effective) ; codec small ~2.3 µs, medium ~5.8 µs, large ~11.6 µs. The high latencies vs D1's mock baselines are real: the v2 fixtures take 8 multi-rounds of fusion to converge through the `MvpCpuFusion` chain (cf. D3 chain at ~190 µs/round × 8 rounds ≈ ~1.5 ms — but with full backend overhead including stats and consensus, ~50 ms/round on medium). Until the first clean post-merge bench run on main, the `results` map is empty and the regression-detection step in `.github/workflows/bench.yml` short-circuits (`cand_val is None: continue`) for every D4 key.
